reason: Even with restricted Drive permissions, I cannot risk client tax records on unproven software until I verify that an assistant accidentally moving or deleting a folder won't orphan our files. objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Guaranteed folder-protection mechanisms against accidental deletion in Google Drive and peer validation at my monthly study circle that client confidentiality is 100% airtight.
